name: Hierarchical Taxonomy Importer
description: Imports taxonomy terms in a hierarchical structure from CSV files.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Hierarchical Taxonomy Import 
 ============================

This module imports taxonomy term on parent-child relationships from a CSV file.

 Back to top 

 Known Bugs 
 ==========

It doesn't update the existing taxonomy tree, so please be extra cautious while importing the data and validate it before starting import.

 Back to top 

 Steps to Import 
 ===============

1. Install the module.

2. Go to Admin/Configurations and then click on Taxonomy Importer.

3. Form will appear where you would select vocabulary to import the data.

4. Upload your CSV file and click on Submit button.
